settings.title: Delivery & Shipping
settings.content: Orders are dispatched within 24–48 hours and typically arrive within 5–7 business days across India.

settings.title: Returns & Replacement
settings.content: Damaged or incorrect items can be reported within 48 hours of delivery for a free replacement. Eligible orders also qualify for a 7-day change-of-mind return from the date of delivery.

settings.title: Need Help?
